documents.text: [ lower-alpha 1 ] Spouse ( s ) Lady Liu Children Jia Chong Jia Hun Occupation General , official Courtesy name Liangdao ( 梁道 ) Posthumous name Marquis Su ( 肅侯 ) Peerage Marquis of Yangli Village ( 陽里亭侯 ) Original name Jia Qu ( 賈衢 ) This is a Chinese name ; the family name is Jia . Jia Kui ( 174-228 ) , originally named Jia Qu , courtesy name Liangdao , was a military general and official who lived during the late Eastern Han dynasty of China .
